name: bifrost-cost-reset
description: Test 3 on Bifrost transports/v2.2.6, run through run-cost.sh with a throwaway key (limits in the run's NOTE.md and quota.json). A $0.0001 budget that resets every minute. Spend it, be refused, wait, and be admitted again: shows when a reset actually lands (swept every 10 s; an expired window is skipped, not denied, until swept).
